privacyPolicy.title: Nordic Nutri Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.lead: Nordic Nutri is designed to make food tracking feel simpler. We also want you to understand how your information is handled. This policy describes the information we may process when you visit our website or use the Android app, why we need it, and how you can contact us about your data.

sections.title: 1. Where this policy applies
sections.content: This policy covers the Nordic Nutri website and Android app. You can browse the public website without creating an account. The meal-recognition demo on the website uses preset food photos and sample results; it does not analyze your own meals. Using account-based and personalized app features may involve the information described below.

sections.title: 2. Information we process
sections.content:
• Account details: Email address, account identifiers, verification and session information needed to sign up, sign in, or recover your account. If Google sign-in is enabled and used, we may receive basic profile information from Google.
• Information you provide: Such as age, height, weight, and dietary or nutrition goals, depending on what you enter or the app requests. Some information may be considered sensitive health-related data under applicable law.
• Meals and nutrition: Food photos you take or select, AI recognition results, nutrition estimates, portion adjustments, meal logs, and history.
• Nova interactions: Questions you submit and limited meal history or preferences needed to provide a relevant reply.
• Technical information: App or device version, request times, error information, and necessary operational or security logs. An enabled reminder feature may also use a push notification identifier.

Please avoid including identity documents, passwords, or other unrelated sensitive information in food images or Nova messages.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
sections.content: We use this information to authenticate accounts, save meal logs, estimate nutrition from images, show trends, respond through Nova, deliver reminders you choose to enable, secure the service, and investigate technical problems. Trying the public website demo does not create an app account or save a real meal log.

sections.title: 4. AI processing and third-party services
sections.content:
When you choose to use meal recognition or Nova, relevant images, text, and limited context necessary for the request may be sent to an AI provider connected to the service. Food recognition and nutrition estimates can be wrong; you should review and adjust them where appropriate.

Depending on which features are enabled, operating the website and app may involve cloud hosting, storage, email delivery, authentication, notifications, and AI providers. Existing technical configurations include CloudBase, Cloudflare, Brevo, Google / Firebase, and models reached through the AI routing service. Not every provider receives your information during every visit or action. An SMS integration should not be treated as an active login feature unless it is actually enabled.

Some providers may process information outside your country or region. Their retention, deletion, use for model training, and international transfer arrangements depend on the specific provider, account settings, and agreements. We do not promise that every third party immediately deletes all data or never uses it for model training. Please consult the relevant provider terms and account settings for their practices.

sections.title: 5. Device permissions and website use
sections.content:
The app may request camera access to photograph a meal, access to a photo you select, or notification permission if you enable reminders. You can manage these permissions in your device settings, although some features may then be unavailable.

The website may store a necessary preference such as your selected language. Hosting providers may produce basic access or security logs. If optional analytics or non-essential cookies are enabled, we will provide the notices and choices required by applicable law.

sections.title: 6. Retention and deletion
sections.content:
We keep information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide features, maintain security, and meet applicable legal requirements. Account details and meal logs are generally held while an account is in use. You can remove records through available in-app controls or contact us to request access, correction, deletion, or account closure.

Deletion may involve database entries, stored photos, logs, backups, and external service providers. Certain security records may need to be retained for a limited period for legitimate or legal reasons. Because automated cleanup, backup rotation, and third-party copies have not all been verified, we do not currently guarantee that every copy will be deleted within a fixed 30- or 90-day period. We will explain the available process, its status, and any reasonable limits when handling a request.

sections.title: 7. Security and international processing
sections.content: We use security measures appropriate to a small independent app, including access controls, authentication, and transport protections, and aim to minimize unnecessary sensitive content in logs. No online service can guarantee perfect security. Data may be processed in another region when cloud or AI services operate there; locations and transfer safeguards must reflect verified production settings and provider terms.

sections.title: 8. Children and younger users
sections.content: Nordic Nutri aims to provide an age-appropriate experience and is not automatically restricted to users aged 18 and over. Where local law requires parental or guardian consent, that consent must be obtained before submitting personal information or using the relevant features. If a legally required verifiable consent process is not yet available, please do not use functions that upload personal profiles, food photos, or Nova content. Public website information and the preset demo remain available. Younger users should not rely on AI output for extreme dieting, weight loss, or other high-risk dietary decisions.

sections.title: 9. Your choices and rights
sections.content: Depending on applicable law, you may be able to request information about your data, access or correct it, ask for deletion or a copy, object to certain processing, or withdraw consent where relevant. You can also manage camera, photo, and notification permissions on your device. Please email us with your request; we may need to verify your identity reasonably to protect your account.

sections.title: 10. Changes and contact
sections.content: If our features, providers, or data practices change materially, we will update this policy and its date and provide notice through the website or app where appropriate. For privacy questions and data requests, contact junqi21263@gmail.com.

termsOfServicePage.title: Nordic Nutri Terms of Service
termsOfServicePage.lead: Welcome to Nordic Nutri, a food-tracking and nutrition-support app maintained by an independent developer. Our aim is to make everyday meal tracking simpler. Please read these terms before using the service.

sections.title: 1. What Nordic Nutri provides
sections.content: The app offers photo-based meal recognition, estimates of calories and nutrients, food logs, daily progress, Nova nutrition Q&A, weekly reflections, and other features available in your installed version. Some features require a connection or an account. The website can be browsed without signing in. Its meal demo uses preset images and simulated results; it does not analyze or save your actual food.

sections.title: 2. Limits of AI and nutrition information
sections.content:
AI may misidentify ingredients, portions, or cooking methods. Calorie, protein, carbohydrate, and fat figures are therefore estimates for general information, not precise measurements. Nova provides general nutrition and lifestyle information, not medical diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, or individualized medical care.

Please check and adjust entries when appropriate. If you have a medical condition, allergy, eating disorder, pregnancy-related concern, or another important health question, consult a qualified professional rather than relying on the app alone.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and eligibility
sections.content:
When using account features, provide an email address or other supported sign-in information that you are entitled to use. Keep passwords and verification codes secure. Do not impersonate someone else, use another person's account, or intentionally bypass security controls. Contact us if you suspect unauthorized access.

We aim to make the service welcoming to different ages. Younger users must comply with local laws governing personal information and obtain parent or guardian consent where required. If an essential consent or verification process is unavailable, please do not register for or use the affected features.

sections.title: 4. Your photos and content
sections.content:
You keep any rights you legally hold in the food photos, text, and records you provide. To deliver recognition, storage, history, reviews, and Nova responses, you authorize Nordic Nutri and necessary service providers to process that content within the scope needed to operate these features. This does not transfer ownership of your content or grant unrelated rights to display it publicly.

Only upload content you are entitled to use. Avoid submitting other people's private information or unrelated highly sensitive material in photos or messages.

sections.title: 5. Fair use
sections.content: Do not attack the service, try to access another user's data, abuse AI requests, distribute illegal content, disrupt the app, or use automation to bypass reasonable security or usage limits. We may apply proportionate temporary restrictions to clearly abusive or unsafe activity and, where appropriate, explain them or offer a way to raise concerns.

sections.title: 6. Availability and pricing
sections.content:
Nordic Nutri currently provides its existing free features as an independent project. Connectivity, device compatibility, cloud and AI providers, maintenance, and technical errors may affect availability. We aim to keep the service working, but cannot promise uninterrupted operation or perfect results.

If paid features are added later, we will explain the relevant prices and terms before they are offered. A change to these terms will not by itself create a charge.

sections.title: 7. Your data and account closure
sections.content: Our Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled and deleted. You may manage records using controls available in the app or contact us to request help with your data or account closure. After closure, some records and features may not be recoverable. Actual deletion depends on supported processes, backups, and limited necessary retention.

sections.title: 8. App and brand rights
sections.content: The Nordic Nutri name, logo, interface, and app materials owned or lawfully used by the operator are protected by applicable law. Do not impersonate Nordic Nutri, distribute an unauthorized modified release under its name, or create a misleading official download channel. Your legal rights in your own content remain yours.

sections.title: 9. Responsibility and applicable law
sections.content:
Nordic Nutri is an information and tracking tool, not a medical service. To the extent allowed by applicable law, we do not make guarantees beyond those required by law about estimated results, network availability, or unverified AI suggestions. Nothing here excludes responsibilities that cannot legally be excluded or takes away mandatory consumer rights.

If a disagreement arises, please contact us first so we can try to resolve it. Any applicable law or dispute process remains subject to mandatory consumer protections in your location. These terms do not impose a single jurisdiction worldwide.

sections.title: 10. Updates and contact
sections.content: We may update the app or these terms for feature, security, or legal reasons. We will provide notice of material changes where appropriate and update the date above. For service, account, or terms questions, contact junqi21263@gmail.com.
